### What's Wrong?

Title: Long-running sessions lose authentication mid-task and require the user to sign in again

What happened: I left an orchestrator session supervising several sub-sessions (Claude desktop app, Code tab) for a full working day. On 2026-11-13 around 10:10 UTC, three sub-sessions ended their turns with Failed to authenticate. API Error: 403 Attention Required! | Cloudflare. When I came back in the evening, the app asked me to sign in again. The sessions did not recover on their own; each had to be prompted again after I signed in.

Impact: The work was time-critical (a merge freeze started 50 minutes later). The interrupted sessions missed their push window. Nothing told me, while I was away, that a sign-in was needed.

Expected: A running task should keep its authentication until it finishes, or refresh it without user action. If a re-sign-in is unavoidable, notify the user at once (push notification) and resume the interrupted turns automatically afterwards.

### What Should Happen?

When Claude Code is running with a long run task, do not disrupt and request sign in authentication
